_comment: Trigger vocabulary for the deterministic greeting/menu classifier. Language data only — no logic. Add more languages/variants here without touching greeting_classifier.py. Match is whole-token, case-folded, same rule as apps/whatsapp-assistant/src/interactions/confirmation_phrases.json. Malayalam entries below are limited to the most common, unambiguous greetings — a native speaker should extend this list rather than trust this as exhaustive.
